## What this is

v1's pie geometry (normalized [0,1] coords + `coord_fixed(ratio = 1)` so
pies are genuinely circular regardless of raw axis ranges) combined with
v3's soft quadrant tints, corner labels, and guide lines. No example
callout.

```{r build}
an09_types <- c("AN09B017a","AN09B017b","AN09B017c","AN09B017d",
                "AN09B017e","AN09B017f","AN09B017g")
an09_present <- intersect(an09_types, rownames(adj.matrix))
mal_present  <- intersect(mal_subtypes, colnames(adj.matrix))

w <- as.matrix(adj.matrix[an09_present, mal_present])
df_wide <- tibble(
  mAL       = mal_present,
  total_pct = colSums(w) * 100,
  delta_ppk = mal_activation_matrix[mal_present, "ppk23"] -
              mal_activation_matrix[mal_present, "ppk25"]
)
for (v in an09_present) df_wide[[v]] <- ifelse(colSums(w) > 0, w[v, ] / colSums(w), 0)
```

## Plot

```{r plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
base_pal <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")
if (length(an09_present) > length(base_pal)) {
  base_pal <- c(base_pal, RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))
}
an09_palette <- setNames(base_pal[seq_along(an09_present)], an09_present)

# --- Raw axis extents (with padding) ---
x_raw <- df_wide$delta_ppk
y_raw <- df_wide$total_pct
x_pad <- 0.08 * diff(range(x_raw))
y_pad <- 0.08 * diff(range(y_raw))
x_lo <- min(x_raw) - x_pad; x_hi <- max(x_raw) + x_pad
y_lo <- min(0, min(y_raw) - y_pad); y_hi <- max(y_raw) + y_pad
x_span <- x_hi - x_lo; y_span <- y_hi - y_lo

# --- Normalize to [0, 1] so coord_fixed(1) gives truly circular pies ---
df_wide$x_n <- (df_wide$delta_ppk - x_lo) / x_span
df_wide$y_n <- (df_wide$total_pct  - y_lo) / y_span

pts <- as.matrix(df_wide[, c("x_n", "y_n")])
d_mat <- as.matrix(dist(pts)); diag(d_mat) <- Inf
pie_r <- max(min(0.45 * min(d_mat), 0.045), 0.022)

# Axis breaks in original units, displayed on [0,1] coords
x_breaks_raw <- pretty(c(min(x_raw), max(x_raw)), n = 5)
y_breaks_raw <- pretty(c(min(y_raw), max(y_raw)), n = 5)
x_breaks_n <- (x_breaks_raw - x_lo) / x_span
y_breaks_n <- (y_breaks_raw - y_lo) / y_span
keep_x <- x_breaks_n >= 0 & x_breaks_n <= 1
keep_y <- y_breaks_n >= 0 & y_breaks_n <= 1
x_breaks_n <- x_breaks_n[keep_x]; x_breaks_raw <- x_breaks_raw[keep_x]
y_breaks_n <- y_breaks_n[keep_y]; y_breaks_raw <- y_breaks_raw[keep_y]

# Key normalized positions
zero_x_n <- (0 - x_lo) / x_span
median_y <- median(y_raw)
median_y_n <- (median_y - y_lo) / y_span

# --- Quadrant backgrounds (in normalized coords) ---
quad_df <- tibble(
  xmin = c(zero_x_n, 0,        0,        zero_x_n),
  xmax = c(1,        zero_x_n, zero_x_n, 1),
  ymin = c(median_y_n, median_y_n, 0,          0),
  ymax = c(1,          1,          median_y_n, median_y_n),
  fill = c("#FDE9D9", "#D9E8FD", "#F2F2F2", "#F2F2F2")
)

# Corner labels (in normalized coords) — positions mirror v3
lbl_y_top <- 1 - 0.02
lbl_y_bot <- 0 + 0.04
quad_labels <- tibble(
  x = c(1 - 0.01, 0 + 0.01, 1 - 0.01, 0 + 0.01),
  y = c(lbl_y_top, lbl_y_top, lbl_y_bot, lbl_y_bot),
  hjust = c(1, 0, 1, 0),
  label = c(
    "male-contact-driven mAL\nstrong AN09B017 input",
    "female-contact-driven mAL\nstrong AN09B017 input",
    "weak AN09B017 involvement\n(ppk23-dominant)",
    "weak AN09B017 involvement\n(ppk25-dominant)"
  ),
  col = c("#B45F06", "#1F4E79", "grey45", "grey45")
)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = quad_df,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = quad_df$fill, alpha = 0.55, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median_y_n, linewidth = 0.4,
             color = "grey45", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = zero_x_n, linewidth = 0.4,
             color = "grey45", linetype = "dashed") +
  # Place the inline guide labels NEAR the crossing point of the two
  # guide lines (x = zero_x_n, y = median_y_n), offset outward into
  # the weak-AN09 zone so they never overlap the bold corner labels.
  annotate("label", x = zero_x_n, y = median_y_n - 0.06,
           label = "ppk balanced", angle = 90,
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.8, color = "grey30",
           fontface = "italic",
           fill = alpha("white", 0.85), label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(1.2, "pt")) +
  annotate("label", x = zero_x_n + 0.06, y = median_y_n,
           label = sprintf("median = %.1f%%", median_y),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.8, color = "grey30",
           fontface = "italic",
           fill = alpha("white", 0.85), label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(1.2, "pt")) +
  geom_text(data = quad_labels,
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, hjust = hjust),
            vjust = 1, size = 3.4, fontface = "bold",
            color = quad_labels$col, lineheight = 0.95) +
  geom_scatterpie(data = df_wide,
                  aes(x = x_n, y = y_n, r = pie_r),
                  cols = an09_present,
                  color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.15) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = an09_palette, name = "AN09B017 variant") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks_n, labels = x_breaks_raw) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks_n, labels = y_breaks_raw) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = df_wide,
                           aes(x = x_n, y = y_n, label = mAL),
                           size = 2.9, color = "grey20",
                           max.overlaps = 30, min.segment.length = 0,
                           box.padding = pie_r * 1.5 + 0.01,
                           point.padding = pie_r * 1.1,
                           segment.color = "grey55", segment.size = 0.25) +
  labs(
    x = expression(ppk23 - ppk25 ~ "(male - female contact drive)"),
    y = "Total AN09B017 input to mAL (% of mAL's total input)",
    title = "AN09B017 input composition per mAL vs ppk asymmetry"
  ) +
  theme_pub(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, color = "grey92"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

save_fig5_plot(p, "panel_B_an09_dominance_vs_ppk_asymmetry_v6", width = 12, height = 9)
print(p)
```
